candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement resetting the caller's credit to zero, so credit persists after withdrawal.
Move the credit reset to after the external call, enabling reentrancy and changing the state during the call.
Replace the transferred value oCredit with 0 so no ether is sent while balance and credit are still reduced.
Delete the statement `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` so credit is never reset, allowing repeated withdrawals of the same credit.
Delete the statement `balance -= oCredit;` so the internal balance is never decremented on withdrawal.
Delete the statement `require(callResult);` so a failed external call no longer reverts, leaving state changed without transferring funds.
Move the external call `msg.sender.call{value: oCredit}("");` to before `balance -= oCredit;`, making the function vulnerable to reentrancy with stale state.
Replace the condition `if (oCredit > 0)` with `if (true)` so withdrawal attempts with zero credit now decrement balance and make a zero-value call, reverting on underflow when balance is 0.
Remove the statement zeroing the sender's credit, so credit is never cleared after withdrawal.
Remove the require(callResult) check so a failed external call no longer reverts the withdrawal.
Move the credit zeroing before the external call, changing state visible during reentrant calls.
